name: agentic/faq-accordion
title: FAQ Accordion
description: Expandable question/answer list. Uses native <details> — no JavaScript. Set introHeading/introText/imageUrl for a 2-column layout with a portrait image beside the eyebrow, heading, and accordion. `imageUrlMobile` is optional — a smaller derivative of `imageUrl` served via `srcset` below the block's 780px stack breakpoint, since this is a static theme asset (not a media-library attachment) with no automatic WordPress srcset of its own; omit it and the block renders exactly as before, one file at every width.

default.question: How long does shipping take?
default.answer: Orders ship within one business day and typically arrive in 3–5 days.

default.question: What is your return policy?
default.answer: Return anything unused within 30 days for a full refund.

default.question: Do you ship internationally?
default.answer: Yes — rates are calculated at checkout.
